newsitem.title: UK: Rotterdam bunkers edge down in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers edge down in quiet trade.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker oil prices fell by $1-2 a tonne on Wednesday in quiet trade amid light demand, brokers said.
They said 380 cst fuel was around $86/88 and 180 cst at $91/93, with Antwerp prices about $1 more. Hamburg was at $94/95 and $99/100 respectively.
The Mediterranean market was torpid. "The market's very quiet in the Med. There's almost no trade," one broker said.
Fos 380 cst was priced at $90 with 180 cst at $99/100.
Fujairah prices were little changed, with 380 cst at $95 and 180 cst at $99. --London newsroom +44 171 542 4088
